sources.summary: Concéntrico returned to Logroño for its 12th edition in June 2026, transforming the city into a working site for architecture . Since its founding in 2015, the festival has built an identity on resisting a distant, controlled exhibition of design by constructing full-scale installations in the city's streets, plazas, and vacant lots. Concéntrico embeds installations directly into daily life, engaging residents and visitors as active, observant participants . This year's program brought together more than twenty projects by architects, designers, and researchers working across geographies and methods , each contributing to a citywide experiment in reimagining public space .
